# Table AI Design Aha

Agent-friendly design guidelines for Table AI Alliance brands.

Machine-readable entry points:
- /api/manifest.json
- /api/brands.json
- /api/brands/{slug}.json

Brands:
- Table AI (tableai): /api/brands/tableai.json
- VANAHOM (vanahom): /api/brands/vanahom.json
- KiND (kind): /api/brands/kind.json
- APHA (apha): /api/brands/apha.json
- MANA Endless (manaendless): /api/brands/manaendless.json
- OPC Global (opcglobal): /api/brands/opcglobal.json
- IPTrustasset (iptrust): /api/brands/iptrust.json
- 峰值永造局 (fengzhi): /api/brands/fengzhi.json
- Axisee (axisee): /api/brands/axisee.json
- Sidera (sidera): /api/brands/sidera.json

Admin workflow:
- /admin.html unlocks with the generated admin key.
- Edits are committed back to GitHub via the GitHub Contents API.
- GitHub Pages rebuilds from main after changes land.
